title: Fourth-Order Energy-Consistent Average Vector Field Discrete Gradient Methods for Dissipative Hamiltonian Systems
summary: Discrete gradient methods provide a structure-preserving approach to energy-consistent time integration of dissipative Hamiltonian systems. In their conventional formulation, however, they generally attain at most second-order convergence. Extending the perturbation principle previously developed for Poisson systems to the dissipative setting, we derive fourth-order average vector field discrete gradient schemes.
